reasons.message: AGC-001 Owner and Inventory is declared only; the profile requires maturity 2.
AGC-009 External Policy Engine is missing.
AGC-013 Disposable Sandbox Environments has an accepted risk that needs a review.
AGC-020 Mandatory Regression Evals could not be assessed because of an error.

controls.title: Owner and Inventory
controls.plain_language: A named person is accountable for the agent, and its tools and data are listed.
controls.status_reason: An owner is declared, but no registry record or signed attestation confirms it. The profile requires maturity 2.
controls.next_action: Attach a signed owner attestation or a registry record as evidence.
remediation: Record the owner, purpose, and registry reference in .agentgov.yaml.
Attach a signed owner attestation or a registry record as evidence.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Dynamic Risk Tiering
controls.plain_language: The agent has a risk level that matches what it can actually do.
controls.status_reason: The declared tier high matches the detected capabilities.
controls.next_action: Declare a risk tier with a written rationale.
remediation: Declare a risk tier with a written rationale.
Review the tier when the agent gains a new capability.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Integrated Change Control
controls.plain_language: Changes to models, tools, and prompts trigger a new assessment before release.
controls.status_reason: No detector produced evidence for this control and no external evidence was supplied.
controls.next_action: Supply test or runtime evidence for this control.
remediation: Run the governance scan in CI on every change to agent files.
Link each release to its commit and artifact hash.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Dedicated Non-Human Identity
controls.plain_language: The agent has its own identity and does not borrow a person's account.
controls.status_reason: A shared service account is configured for the agent.
controls.next_action: Create a dedicated workload identity for the agent.
remediation: Create a dedicated workload identity for the agent.
Remove shared and personal credentials from the agent configuration.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Allowlisted Tool Access
controls.plain_language: The agent can only use tools on an approved list.
controls.status_reason: A test shows that a tool outside the allowlist is rejected.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Define an explicit tool allowlist with deny by default.
remediation: Define an explicit tool allowlist with deny by default.
Add a test that calls a tool outside the list and expects a rejection.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Short-Lived Scoped Tokens
controls.plain_language: Access tokens expire quickly and only grant what the task needs.
controls.status_reason: Evidence was supplied but it expired on 2026-01-01.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Submit a current token lifetime test result.
remediation: Issue tokens with a short lifetime, a narrow scope, and a fixed audience.
Test expired and wrong-audience tokens against a mock identity provider.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: User-Enforced Data Layer
controls.plain_language: The agent only sees data that the current user is allowed to see.
controls.status_reason: The cross-user access test was not rejected.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Pass the caller identity to every data-access tool.
remediation: Pass the caller identity to every data-access tool.
Enforce the filter in the data service, not in the prompt.
Add a two-user test that expects cross-user reads to fail.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Vault-Injected Secrets
controls.plain_language: Secrets come from a vault at run time and are never written in code.
controls.status_reason: A credential is written in source code.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Remove the hardcoded value and rotate the credential.
remediation: Remove the hardcoded value and rotate the credential.
Load secrets from a vault through the workload identity.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: External Policy Engine
controls.plain_language: A separate rule engine checks sensitive actions before they run.
controls.status_reason: The scanner looked for a policy enforcement point and found none.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Route sensitive tool calls through a policy enforcement point.
remediation: Route sensitive tool calls through a policy enforcement point.
Deny by default when the policy service is unavailable.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Human Approval Gates
controls.plain_language: A person must approve risky actions before the agent carries them out.
controls.status_reason: The approval bypass test failed.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Require an external approval bound to the actor, the exact action, and an expiry time.
remediation: Require an external approval bound to the actor, the exact action, and an expiry time.
Test bypass, replay, and expired approval cases.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Dual Content Guardrails
controls.plain_language: Inputs and outputs are checked, including text returned by tools.
controls.status_reason: Validators are present in code. No adversarial test result was supplied.
controls.next_action: Validate tool returns before the model reads them.
remediation: Validate tool returns before the model reads them.
Add adversarial fixtures for injected instructions.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Multi-Level Resource Limits
controls.plain_language: The agent has limits on steps, cost, time, and spending.
controls.status_reason: Signed runtime records show the limits working.
controls.next_action: Set limits for steps, tokens, run time, and transaction amounts.
remediation: Set limits for steps, tokens, run time, and transaction amounts.
Test a bounded loop and an over-limit request.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Disposable Sandbox Environments
controls.plain_language: Code and commands run in a locked-down environment that is thrown away afterwards.
controls.status_reason: An approved exception accepts this risk until 2027-01-31.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Have a reviewer confirm that the exception is still acceptable.
remediation: Run tool execution as a non-root user with a read-only file system.
Drop capabilities and restrict network access.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Vetted Tool Supply Chain
controls.plain_language: Tools, MCP servers, and dependencies are pinned and come from known sources.
controls.status_reason: The MCP server is not pinned and no provenance record was found.
controls.next_action: Pin every MCP server and dependency to a version or digest.
remediation: Pin every MCP server and dependency to a version or digest.
Record provenance for container images.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Context Memory Integrity
controls.plain_language: What the agent remembers is validated and kept separate for each user.
controls.status_reason: No persistent memory was detected.
controls.applicability_reason: No capability that triggers this control was detected.
controls.next_action: Confirm that the agent does not have this capability.
remediation: Validate content before it is written to memory.
Separate memory by user and set a retention period.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Authenticated Inter-Agent Messages
controls.plain_language: Agents prove who they are before they act on each other's messages.
controls.status_reason: No agent-to-agent messaging was detected.
controls.applicability_reason: No capability that triggers this control was detected.
controls.next_action: Confirm that the agent does not have this capability.
remediation: Authenticate every agent-to-agent request.
Add replay protection and scoped authority.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Instant Agent Kill Switch
controls.plain_language: Operators can stop the agent and revoke its access at once.
controls.status_reason: A cancellation path exists. Termination was not tested.
controls.next_action: Run a synthetic stop-and-revoke test.
remediation: Add central revocation that cancels running jobs.
Run a stop-and-revoke test and record the time to stop.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Reversible Action Design
controls.plain_language: Actions can be undone, or are approved when they cannot be.
controls.status_reason: A document describes a manual reversal. No code path or test confirms it.
controls.applicability_reason: The agent has a capability that this control governs.
controls.next_action: Make mutating operations idempotent.
remediation: Make mutating operations idempotent.
Add a compensation step or record why an action is not reversible.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Dedicated Incident Runbook
controls.plain_language: There is a written, practiced plan for when the agent misbehaves.
controls.status_reason: A runbook file exists. No exercise record was supplied.
controls.next_action: Write an agent-specific runbook with owner and escalation path.
remediation: Write an agent-specific runbook with owner and escalation path.
Run an exercise and record the result.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Mandatory Regression Evals
controls.plain_language: Tests for allowed and forbidden behavior run on every change.
controls.status_reason: The test report reports/junit.xml could not be parsed.
controls.next_action: Fix the test report and scan again.
remediation: Add versioned behavior tests that run in CI.
Submit the CI results as evidence.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Continuous Red Teaming
controls.plain_language: The agent is attacked on purpose, repeatedly, to find weaknesses.
controls.status_reason: No detector produced evidence for this control and no external evidence was supplied.
controls.next_action: Supply test or runtime evidence for this control.
remediation: Add repeatable adversarial scenarios for prompt injection and tool misuse.
Import the results through the evidence adapter.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Complete Step Tracing
controls.plain_language: Every decision and tool call is recorded and can be followed end to end.
controls.status_reason: A synthetic end-to-end trace was recorded and verified.
controls.next_action: Correlate runs, tool calls, and approvals with one trace ID.
remediation: Correlate runs, tool calls, and approvals with one trace ID.
Record a synthetic end-to-end trace as evidence.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Tamper-Evident Audit Trail
controls.plain_language: Audit records cannot be changed without detection.
controls.status_reason: Only plain application logs were found.
controls.next_action: Write audit records to protected or hash-chained storage.
remediation: Write audit records to protected or hash-chained storage.
Run a tampering test on sample records.
limitations: A static scan cannot confirm how this control behaves in production.

controls.title: Real-Time Operational Monitoring
controls.plain_language: Unusual agent behavior raises an alert while it is happening.
controls.status_reason: No detector produced evidence for this control and no external evidence was supplied.
controls.next_action: Supply test or runtime evidence for this control.
remediation: Define alerts for denied policy decisions and unusual tool use.
Send a synthetic signal and confirm that an alert fires.

findings.title: Refunds run without an enforced approval
findings.description: The tool issue_refund executes when the approval record is absent. The approval check reads a flag that the model can set.
findings.why_it_matters: The agent can move money without any person agreeing to it.
remediation: Require an external approval bound to the actor, the exact action, and an expiry time.
Reject the call when no valid approval record exists.
Add tests for bypass, replay, and expired approvals.

findings.title: Credential written in source code
findings.description: A value that looks like an API credential is assigned to a variable. The value is not shown in this report.
findings.why_it_matters: Anyone who can read the repository can use the credential.
remediation: Remove the value from the code and rotate the credential.
Load the secret from a vault at run time.

findings.title: Invoice lookup does not filter by the current user
findings.description: The query in lookup_invoice has no caller filter, and the cross-user test was not rejected.
findings.why_it_matters: One customer can read another customer's invoices through the agent.
remediation: Enforce caller-specific authorization in the data service.
Pass the caller identity to lookup_invoice.
Keep the two-user test in CI.

findings.title: Agent uses a shared service account
findings.description: The configuration sets the account name svc-finance-shared, which other services also use.
findings.why_it_matters: Actions by the agent cannot be told apart from actions by other systems.
remediation: Create a dedicated workload identity for the agent.
Remove the shared account from the configuration.

findings.title: No policy check before sensitive tools
findings.description: No policy enforcement point was found between the model and the tools issue_refund and send_payment_notice.
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing outside the model decides whether a sensitive action is allowed.
remediation: Route sensitive tool calls through a policy enforcement point.
Deny by default when the policy service does not answer.

findings.why_it_matters: A tool that nobody reviewed can still be called by the agent.
remediation: Add the tool to declared_tools with a scope, or remove it.
